title: Reshmi Dor
description: Braid a rakhi out of silk. Rub the screen and three strands plait themselves into a cord — the real three-strand plait, solved in 3D, where the strand travelling inward always passes in front. Your hand sets the rhythm: rub slowly for a tight braid, quickly for a long, loose one. Change the silk mid-cord, thread beads, pearls, mirrors and ghungroo bells onto the crossings, then close the ring and tie it — the flower blooms, the tassels drop, and marigold petals fall. Every crossing plucks a string in Raga Desh, the monsoon raga of Shravan. The rakhis you tie are kept in a box you can come back to.
